completedModelVideo.inspection: Paused/inspected at 1:35 and 2:10. Both show the completed craft with the open low base and offset radial plane from an upper/side three-quarter view; no full turnaround, opposite-side, top or underside view was verified. At 2:10 the reviewer infers that the rider seat rocks; this remains a secondary inference, not a sourced construction requirement.

directlyShown: Assembled Martian vehicle with low open green/turquoise base
One Martian rider in orange mechanical frame
Dark-green raised block with a translucent-green beacon
Horizontal three-blade propeller shown in assembly steps below the radial part
inferredByComparison: The assembled 1195 vehicle is visibly asymmetric in the shown three-quarter views.
The dish/ring and underside propeller are connected to the craft as one source vehicle; unseen attachment detail is not resolved.
unknownOrDisputed: Rear, top, opposite side, and complete underside views were not found.
The instruction archive exposes two booklet pages; page 3 is unavailable.
The official LEGO service page lists the instruction service, but no official 1195 PDF was found.
Source material does not show a second rider seat or establish the structural load path of a game-capacity-2 vehicle.
